subject.title: Feature: Handle Signal message edits (editMessage envelope)

question: What should be authoritative when a Signal edit arrives after the original message may already be stored or running: append an explicit edit event, replace the prior context entry, or cancel and re-run from corrected content?
rationale: signal-cli supplies the target identity, but OpenClaw has no established contract for mutating prior transcript context or deciding whether edits should wake an agent after dispatch.

options.title: Append structured edit event
options.body: Keep the original history, add target-linked corrected content, and wake only under an explicit mention or active-turn policy.

options.title: Replace prior context
options.body: Mutate the authoritative prior inbound entry and define behavior for persisted transcripts and already-running turns.

options.title: Cancel and re-run
options.body: Cancel work triggered by the original and dispatch corrected content, aligning with broader recall/edit cancellation at substantially larger scope.

recommendation.title: Append structured edit event
recommendation.body: Keep the original history, add target-linked corrected content, and wake only under an explicit mention or active-turn policy.

likelyOwner.reason: The strongest available history and prior discussion both connect this person to Signal inbound routing and the unresolved behavior choice.
